answer: Because your offer was issued before February 1, 2026, it keeps its original terms: 7 days or 300 additional miles, whichever came first. With an offer from December 2025, the 7-day limit has long since passed, so that offer has expired. You can request a new one at any time, though the amount will reflect current market prices and may be higher or lower. A new offer would be good for 5 days or 250 additional miles, whichever comes first.
